lines.1: Otome had gone out to spend the whole day with her friends.
lines.2: So I decided to hang out with the usual three childhood idiots.
lines.4: 「Good. Talking with my friends has put me back on my feet.」
lines.5: 「I must get back into my old rhythm at once.」
lines.6: 「It is already quite late, but first I shall resume my cooking practice!」
lines.8: 「Whew. Babysitting Crab really takes it out of you.」
lines.9: 「Huh? I hear something downstairs... Does that mean Otome's home too?」
lines.10: It was already late at night.
lines.11: What was she doing down there?
lines.13: 「Yes. This time my cooking came out much better.」
lines.14: 「Would you care to taste it? Here.」
lines.17: 「No. That is not what I meant.」
lines.18: 「Right. Better make sure the stove's completely off.」
lines.47: 「Why are you being so cruel to me?」
lines.52: 「And I'm telling you, I feel the same!」
lines.59: It was such a crushing punch, it made Murata's fists seem lovable.
lines.60: A point-blank right straight with no hope of dodging.
lines.62: That was how far my consciousness went flying.
lines.64: I blacked out on the spot.
